notes.title: Hexrite Demo Patch 1 Notes
notes.notes:
The Hexrite Demo has been out for a few weeks and we've been listening and noting down all your feedback and bug reports, and we have now released our first major patch to make your demo experience better and smoother.

You'll find that you're playing the right version if you see [b]'Hexrite v.0.4.4'[/b] on the top right corner of your screen whilst playing. 

Please check out the patch notes below:

[h1]Player Feedback 📝[/h1]
[list]
[*] After performing an air attack, you can now finish it up with a follow-up.
[*] You can also now hit the ground earlier after a double jump by attacking in the air.
[*] When respawning, you now get a visual pointer to the main objective of the level.
[*] Extended i-frames when dodging.
[*] You can now dodge out of the ‘getting hit’ animation earlier.
[*] Enemy collision capsules have been made larger.
[*] You can now double jump if you walk out of a platform by accident!
[*] Some settings (like audio preferences) now save in-between game launches.
[*] Gamepad button prompts now default to XBOX icons.
[*] Dialogue has been adjusted (and Captain Nemo now makes it more clear he wants to speak with you at the beginning of the demo).
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes 🐛[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed several menu issues.
[*] Fixed some minor issues with the Engage mechanic.
[*] You can now use your gamepad of choice more reliably when navigating through menus.
[*] Fixed a softlock situation on the platforming section after the second optional path in the level.
[*] When coming back from [REDACTED], enemies don’t respawn and attack you relentlessly anymore.
[*] Captain Nemo doesn’t laugh infinitely anymore in certain occasions. 
[*] Made the floating gem on the first optional path a bit more obvious and added wisps to lead the player more visibly to it.
[*] It’s now easier to go up the stairs in the tower platforming section of the demo.
[*] You can now reliably obtain the second hidden spell in the level.
[*] When sprinting during the demo’s boss fight, the entire screen won’t become blurry anymore.
[/list]

Our next patch will be focused on performance improvements, QoL tweaks and further minor bug fixes.

Thank you very much for your feedback and we look forward to hearing your comments on the new patch! 🔮

notes.title: Hexrite Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce that the demo for Hexrite has now released on Steam! You can download it straight from the main store page!

Explore the coral-filled Nuvemar, face a series of challenging bizarre enemies and meet the Dream Empress at the top of her ruined castle! 

Don't forget to join our Discord for any bug reports or feedback you might have, alternatively you can talk with us through the Steam Forums, enjoy the demo and thank you for all your support thus far!

notes.title: Hexrite wins Best Game at the PlayStation Talents Awards!
notes.notes:
Last week during our first public showing of Hexrite at both Lisboa Games Week and MEO XL Games, Hexrite was one of the 10 finalists for the PlayStation Talents Awards, being nominated for 3 categories: Best Game Award, Press Award and Best Art Award.

We're happy to announce we've won 2 of these:

🏆 [b]Best Game Award![/b]
🏆 [b]Press Award![/b]

This award means that in the future we'll be able to not only release the game on Steam (PC) but also consoles linked to the PlayStation environment, this will also help us further continue the development of Hexrite.

We got good and valuable feedback from both events and will be applying it to the game now, we'll be back soon with more news!

Thank you for your support!
